title: Compatible open stalk tensor coordinates and ordinary target transport
statement: Let f:X\to S, f':X'\to S', g:S'\to S and g':X'\to X form a cartesian square [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Fix an open U of X, T=X'\times_X U with p:T\to X', q:T\to U, its induced cartesian square, a point z0 of T, an integer i and any unbounded complex P of O_X-modules. Assume the scheme module categories have derived categories. Put z=p(z0), P0=restrict(U.ι)(P), Pg=tensorPullback(g')(P), Pg0=tensorPullback(q)(P0). The two diagrams have stalk rings R,A,B,D and R0,A0,B0,D0, stalk complexes Q,Q0 and ordinary tensor complexes V,V0 as in [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. There exist ring isomorphisms eR,eA,eB,eD, a chain isomorphism qC:Q\cong restrictScalars(eA)(Q0), and t:V\cong restrictScalars(eD)(V0), with eA and eB intertwining the two base algebra maps, eD carrying the image of a\otimes b to the image of eA(a)\otimes eB(b), and t(d\otimes x)=eD(d)\otimes qC(x) in every degree. Let F,F0 forget the final stalk-ring scalars, c be the exact restrictScalars homology isomorphism, and k,k0 be homology of tensorStalkIso followed by comparisonStalkHomologyIso inverse [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-pullback]. Then F(H^i(t));F(c.hom);F0(k0)=F(k);eta;HU(d.hom), where eta is the component of openDerivedStalkIso(p,z0,i) on Q(Pg) [def-pc-open-derived-stalk-iso], HU is additive derived stalk cohomology at z0, and d=openRestrictedTensorDerivedIso(g',U,P) [def-pc-open-restricted-tensor-complex-iso]. This statement contains no localized tensor comparison and no base-derived tensor source.

source.place: Lemma 6.26.4, stalks of pullback; Tag 0D5U, section 20.32 opening paragraph, exact open restriction. Geometric coordinate portion of the ordinary comparison square.

proof.text: Obtain normalized ring and input-complex coordinates from exists_openRestricted_stalk_coordinates.

Specialize the tensor-ring compatibility to a tensor 1 to get compatibility of the A-to-D scalar maps. Construct a semilinear tensor equivalence using TensorProduct.congr in each degree; prove D-linearity by tensor induction. Naturality of q for differentials gives HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents and its pure tensor formula.
Apply openRestricted_tensor_homology_transport to the constructed t, the normalization of eD and q, and the pure tensor formula. Combine with the three ring compatibility identities.

theorem exists_openRestricted_tensor_coordinate_data
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (U : X.Opens)
    (sq0 : IsPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') (U.ι ≫ f) g)
    (z0 : (pullback g' U.ι : Scheme.{u})) (i : ℤ)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let z := pullback.fst g' U.ι z0
    let P0 := ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let Pg := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let Pg0 := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj P0
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F0 := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((pullback g' U.ι).presheaf.stalk z0)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let HU := comparisonStalkCohomology (pullback g' U.ι) z0 i ⋙ F0
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (R f g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B f' z))
    letI := leftAlgebra (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0
    letI := rightAlgebra (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
      g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sq0 z0
    letI := (tensorMap (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
      g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sq0 z0).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} (R (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') z0))
    let R0 := R (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0
    let A0 := A (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0
    let B0 := B (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') z0
    let D0 := C z0
    let Q := stalkComplex g' z P
    let Q0 := stalkComplex (pullback.snd g' U.ι) z0 P0
    let V0 := tensorComplex (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
      g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sq0 z0 P0
    ∃ (eR : R f g' z ≃+* R0) (eA : A g' z ≃+* A0)
      (eB : B f' z ≃+* B0) (eD : C z ≃+* D0)
      (q : Q ≅ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} eA.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q0)
      (t : tensorComplex f f' g g' sq z P ≅
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} eD.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj V0),
      (∀ r : R f g' z,
        eA (algebraMap (R f g' z) (A g' z) r) = algebraMap R0 A0 (eR r)) ∧
      (∀ r : R f g' z,
        eB (algebraMap (R f g' z) (B f' z) r) = algebraMap R0 B0 (eR r)) ∧
      (∀ (a : A g' z) (b : B f' z),
        eD (algebraMap (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z) (C z) (a ⊗ₜ[R f g' z] b)) =
          algebraMap (A0 ⊗[R0] B0) D0 (eA a ⊗ₜ[R0] eB b)) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℤ) (d : C z) (x : Q.X k),
        t.hom.f k (d ⊗ₜ[A g' z, (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).comp
          (algebraMap (A g' z) (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z))] x) =
        eD d ⊗ₜ[A0, (tensorMap (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
          g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sq0 z0).comp
          (algebraMap A0 (A0 ⊗[R0] B0))] (show Q0.X k from q.hom.f k x)) ∧
      F.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap t.hom i) ≫
          F.map ((V0.sc i).mapHomologyIso
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} eD.toRingHom)).hom ≫
          F0.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (tensorStalkIso (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
              g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sq0 z0 P0).hom i ≫
            (comparisonStalkHomologyIso (pullback g' U.ι) z0 Pg0 i).inv) =
        F.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z P).hom i ≫
          (comparisonStalkHomologyIso X' z Pg i).inv) ≫
          (openDerivedStalkIso (pullback.fst g' U.ι) z0 i).hom.app
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Pg) ≫ HU.map (openRestrictedTensorDerivedIso g' U P).hom
